issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after an unconditional return.
issues.detail: The function returns the URL form, then has a commented data-URI alternative below the return that readers skimming or copy-pasting will miss or misuse. Split into two named functions or move the alternative into a comment block above the return. Flagged independently by Pike and Torvalds.

issues.description: 'next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)' is gratuitous cleverness in teaching code.
issues.detail: Use pipeline.nodes[0] or look the node up by name. The generator expression suggests filtering that isn't happening and gets cargo-culted by readers. Docs examples should show the obvious idiom. Flagged by Pike and Torvalds.

issues.description: 'Using preview functions with data context' closure example contradicts its own framing.
issues.detail: The section says preview functions lack access to inputs/outputs, then demonstrates a closure over a hardcoded sample_data literal rather than actual data context. Either show loading from the catalog inside preview_fn, or drop the section. The prose muddies what is otherwise a clean zero-arg callable contract.

issues.description: preview_fn signature and node.preview() error semantics are unspecified.
issues.detail: Docs never state the required preview_fn signature, whether async is allowed, what node.preview() returns when preview_fn is absent, or how exceptions propagate. Best-practice item 5 punts to try/except without defining kedro's behavior on failure. Pin pre/postconditions before this leaves experimental.

issues.description: meta overloads opaque metadata and renderer configuration through one untyped dict.
issues.detail: Docs explicitly use meta for both contextual metadata and renderer hints (Mermaid layout, code language, textStyle CSS), conflating distinct contracts and mixing Mermaid library config with Kedro-Viz-specific keys. Separate render config from meta or at minimum document reserved keys and ownership. Flagged by Liskov and Pike.

issues.description: Unrelated Vale config tweaks bundled into a docs PR and checklist left half-done.
issues.detail: PR mixes preview_fn docs with Vale headings exception and ignore.txt additions; these belong in a separate commit with rationale. The author's own checklist also leaves RELEASE.md unchecked for a user-facing feature — add a one-line release note or split the patch. Flagged by Pike and Torvalds.

synthesis.summary: Docs-only PR adding a substantial nodes.md section for the experimental preview_fn feature. The prose is broadly useful but the examples have the kind of small sloppiness that propagates: unreachable returns in ImagePreview, gratuitous next()-over-generator where indexing belongs, and a 'data context' closure that closes over a literal instead of data. The underlying contract is also under-specified — preview_fn signature, node.preview() error semantics, and the dual role of meta as both metadata and renderer config need pinning before this leaves experimental. Unrelated Vale config changes and an unchecked RELEASE.md box should be split or addressed before landing.
